name: Childhood Friend
source:
She and [url=/c100642]Protagonist[/url] lived together during their childhood, and they have a relation akin to step-siblings (customizable to half-siblings). After five years, her mother [url=/c100646]Ashley[/url] broke up with [url=/c100657]Gerald[/url] and cut all ties with him and [url=/c100642]Protagonist[/url].
Now, she is the co-owner of the hotel with her cousin [url=/c100644]Cousin[/url]. Her aunt is [url=/c100653]Thrisha[/url]. Her boyfriend is [url=/c100656]Brodie[/url], but because of his job their contact is sporadic.
